name: Shri Sharadchandra Pawar
permanent_address: Bungalow No.2, Silver Oak Estate, Bhulabhai Desai Road, Malabar Hill, Mumbai 400026
books: (i) 'Fast Forward' - a collection of his speeches was released by the Hon'ble Prime Minister of India in 2008 and (ii) 'On My Terms', released by the President of India in December, 2015
social_activities: President, (i) Nehru Centre, Mumbai, (ii) Rayat Shikshan Sanstha, Satara, (iii) Vidya Pratishthan, Baramati, Pune, (iv) Agriculture Development Trust, Baramati, (v) Y.B. Chavan Pratishthan, Mumbai, (vi) Vasantdada Sugar Institute, Pune and (vii) Co-generation Association of India; agriculture, horticulture, economics, irrigation, energy, finance and sports
hobbies: President, (i) Garware Club House, (ii) Maharashtra Kustigir Parishad and (iii) Mumbai Cricket Association; Ex-President, (i) Maharashtra State Olympic Association, (ii) The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) and (iii) International Cricket Council (ICC); reading and travelling
other_information: Conferred, ‘Padma Vibhushan’ in 2017; has been awarded the "Outstanding Parliamentarian Award, 2003" by the then President, Smt. Pratibha Devisingh Patil; President, Congress (S) President, Nationalist Congress Party (N.C.P.) since 10 June 1999; Conferred, (i) Honorary Doctorate in Humanities by the Lawrence Technological University, Southfield, Michigan, U.S.A., May 2008, (ii) 'D. Litt' by Tilak Maharashtra Vidyapeeth, Pune, Maharashtra, November 2008, (iii) 'Doctor of Science' by Orissa University of Agriculture and Technology, Bhubaneswar, Odisha, December 2008, (iv) 'Doctor of Science' by Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Agriculture University, Parbhani, Maharashtra, February 2013, (v) Degree of Doctor of Letters (Honoris Causa) by Dr. D.Y. Patil Vidyapeeth, Pimpri, Pune, Maharashtra, June 2015 and (vi) Honorary Doctorate of Science (Honoris Causa) by MGM Institute of Health Sciences, Aurangabad, June 2015; awarded the Krishi Ratna Award by Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri, Maharashtra, October 2008
